measurement_method: 人工锁定地面左/前/右角横坐标，alpha>=200该列最下边界定位纵坐标；端点不确定度±4源像素。补充完整可见边缘鲁棒直线拟合（排除入口凸出的台阶及离主边>6px点）；不挑有利局部。

candidate_records.prompt: Precise geometry correction of this same Ming Jiangnan Buddhist temple sprite. Preserve detailed timber, gray tiled roof, lime walls, entrance and tiny interior religious statue, restrained realistic materials, upper-left light and true alpha. Correct the camera to perfect 2:1 orthographic with both ground axes exactly +/-0.5. Current LEFT facade base is slightly too flat: steepen that ground axis from .466 to .500. Current RIGHT base slope -.515 should become -.500. For the thin rectangular stone base use LEFT(120,633), FRONT(876,1011), RIGHT(1470,714), BACK(714,336). These specify a14x11m ground parallelogram. Zoom whole output out uniformly5% for margin if necessary, no crop. All straight building axes must follow the corrected base, no perspective. Maintain exactly the same building composition; only a very slight camera rotation toward45degree yaw. Show all base corners clearly. No labels, grid, numbers, text, people, modern objects, shadows outside base, backdrop, glow or checkerboard. Actual alpha transparency.
candidate_records.acceptance_note: 第3轮2选1改善候选；双轴或占地比残差仍未通过，selected不等于passed；仍为candidate。仅透明裁切、等比Lanczos重采样与16px透明pad。

candidate_records.prompt: Paint a realistic Ming Jiangnan Buddhist temple hall ON THIS EXACT STONE FLOOR. The floor boundary must remain fixed, do not move corners or change the parallelogram. Dark clay tiled hip-and-gable roof, chestnut wood pillars and straight lattice doors, white plaster side walls, tiny seated religious statue inside. Keep entire temple compact WITHIN this base with a clear narrow stone rim. Front entrance and shallow steps on the longer left-front side, steps inside base. Strict orthographic 2:1 camera aligned exactly to reference floor: both horizontal ground axes slope+0.5/-0.5.14m wide11m deep. Fine ancient Chinese game architectural miniature, real tile details and woodgrain, restrained natural shades, daylight from upper left. No outside scenery or thick island platform. No text, numbers, people, symbols, grid, signs, modern objects, watermark. True transparent alpha outside subject, no halo. Complete intact roof and base with margin.
candidate_records.rejection_reason: 双轴/占地比未同时通过，不能作为已验收素材
